QuestInfo.name: Horntail? Horntail!
QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# and #p2400006# set off to find the dragon that most likely held the relic. They were told by #p2411009# that the dragon would be near #b#MDmap321190300##k. Surely things will go easier this time...
QuestInfo.1: Alpha and Beta encountered #p2411011#! Would they find a friend in this mighty monster, or yet another battle?
QuestInfo.2: The fight with #p2411011# was quicker than they could have imagined... and then the dragon began to cry! #p2400005# and #p2400006# didn't know what to do, but a man named #p2411010# appeared to console the monster before they could act... Things were getting strange.
